name: Websites - Authorized - Source Code & Developer Tools Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized source code and developer-tools domains — populate with sanctioned SCM / dev-tool platforms (e.g., github.acme.com (Enterprise), gitlab.acme.com, bitbucket.acme.com, artifactory.acme.com, jfrog.com). Drives the Authorized split on D1070 / D1070A / M1060 (Internal source code, including the secrets-augmented critical surface) and is negated to define the Unauthorized SCM surface on D1071 / M1061 / W1061 / B1060. Top priority. Exclusions: do not add public registries unless you actively use them as corporate dependencies; do not add personal-account git hosts.
